{"subject":"Predictable p99 reads for multi-region fraud scoring","body":"Hi Tom,

Northwind Payments' fraud scoring needs single-digit millisecond reads across three regions at 40k transactions per second, and your team is now focused on evaluating cost and latency improvements for that multi-region data layer.

That's the kind of workload ScyllaDB was built for: a shard-per-core C++ architecture with no JVM garbage-collection pauses, so p99 latency stays predictable under load.

If useful, I'm happy to share how that design behaves on a read-heavy, multi-region pattern like yours.

Oz
GTM Engineer, ScyllaDB
